content: Every Saturday, the market in the town square came alive before sunrise. Traders arrived with baskets of yams, tomatoes and peppers, and set up their stalls under colourful umbrellas. Buyers moved from stall to stall, haggling over prices and greeting old friends. The air was filled with the smell of roasted corn and the sound of bargaining. By noon, the market was crowded, and the traders counted their money with smiles. For many families, market day was not only a time to buy and sell, but also a time to meet, share news and strengthen the bonds of the community.

content: The final match of the inter-house competition was played on a hot afternoon. The crowd cheered as the two teams ran onto the field. In the first half, neither team could score, and the goalkeepers made brilliant saves. After the break, the blue team scored a fine goal, and their supporters erupted in joy. The red team fought back, but the match ended one goal to nothing. The blue team lifted the trophy, and the captain thanked his teammates for their hard work.
